rights: Owner-provided recordings; app embedding explicitly requested by the owner. No CC0 or third-party licence claimed.
missing_variant: E2 has one available recorded attack; shared for soft and medium string synthesis.
format: Gapless 192 kbps MP3 with Xing/LAME encoder-delay metadata, original stereo chord recordings and mono 22050 Hz strings; tuner PCM is 16-bit mono 22050 Hz.
preparation: scripts/prepare-recorded-guitar.py; source WAV masters unchanged. Chord masters approved before encoding. No looping or time stretching.
rhythm_order: Practical order by broad pop/rock usefulness, not a measured global popularity ranking. Old Faithful first, basic quarter/eighth patterns next, style-specific patterns later.
loading: Chord banks are loaded individually. Web Audio keeps at most 48 decoded cache entries; existing native prepared-PCM cache handles immediate repeated auditions.
